other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama: same name 'Mbugubugu' (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: A forest Cissus, named by science only in 1993, whose young leaves come up crimson-purple.
teaser.sw: *Cissus* wa msituni, aliyepewa jina la kisayansi mwaka 1993 tu, ambaye majani yake machanga huchipuka yakiwa na rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu.

summary.en: This mdokadoka is a forest liana of the grape family, found only on the coast of south-east Kenya and eastern Tanzania. Like its relatives it has fleshy leaves and brittle stems.
summary.sw: Mdokadoka huu ni mtambaa wa msituni wa familia ya mizabibu, unaopatikana tu katika pwani ya kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na mashariki mwa Tanzania. Kama jamaa zake, una majani yenye nyama na mashina yanayovunjika kwa urahisi.

about.en: *Cissus sylvicola* is a liana that can climb to about 12 metres. It has tendrils and lateral roots that are often swollen into tubers. Its leaves are slightly to markedly fleshy and hairless, varying from diamond-shaped to oval or round, sometimes shallowly lobed. Young leaves are usually crimson-purple and turn green as they mature. Like other *mdokadoka*, its stem breaks easily, and Digo people identify it by the stem rather than the leaves.
about.sw: *Cissus sylvicola* ni mtambaa unaoweza kupanda hadi mita 12 hivi. Una vikonyo na mizizi ya pembeni ambayo mara nyingi huvimba ikawa viazi. Majani yake yana nyama kidogo hadi nyingi na hayana manyoya, umbo lake likitofautiana kutoka la almasi hadi yai au mviringo, wakati mwingine yakiwa na pembe za kina kifupi. Majani machanga kwa kawaida huwa na rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu na hugeuka kijani yanapokomaa. Kama *mdokadoka* wengine, shina lake hukatika kwa urahisi, na Wadigo huutambua kwa shina badala ya majani.

where.en: It grows in evergreen forest, forest on rocky hills and coral limestone thicket, from near sea level to about 500 metres. Its range runs from south-east Kenya to eastern Tanzania. *Sylvicola* means 'forest-dweller'.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu isiyopukutisha majani, misitu ya vilima vyenye mawe na vichaka vya chokaa ya matumbawe, kutoka karibu na usawa wa bahari hadi mita 500 hivi. Eneo lake huanzia kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi mashariki mwa Tanzania. *Sylvicola* maana yake ni 'mkaaji wa msituni'.

culture.en: Pakia explains *mdokadoka* as 'breaking', because the stem breaks (*doka*) easily, and *mbugubugu* as the basic Digo name for a climber.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza *mdokadoka* kuwa 'kukatika', kwa sababu shina hukatika (*doka*) kwa urahisi, na *mbugubugu* kuwa jina la msingi la Kidigo la mtambaa.

names.en: Digo: *mdokadoka*, 'breaking', and *mbugubugu*, 'climber', shared with Duruma and Giriama. Pakia gives the same two names to *Cissus rotundifolia* and *C. quinquangularis*, so the Digo do not separate these three species by name. No English or Swahili name is recorded. Botanists described the species in the *Flora of Tropical East Africa* in 1993.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdokadoka*, 'kukatika', na *mbugubugu*, 'mtambaa', linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Pakia anatoa majina hayo hayo mawili kwa *Cissus rotundifolia* na *C. quinquangularis*, kwa hiyo Wadigo hawazitenganishi spishi hizi tatu kwa majina. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wataalamu wa mimea waliieleza spishi hii katika *Flora of Tropical East Africa* mwaka 1993.

conservation.en: It has a small range, limited to coastal forest and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania. These are habitats under pressure from clearing, although the species has not been formally assessed as threatened.
conservation.sw: Eneo lake ni dogo, likiwa limedhibitiwa kwenye misitu ya pwani na vichaka nchini Kenya na Tanzania. Haya ni makazi yanayokabiliwa na shinikizo la ukataji, ingawa spishi hii haijatathminiwa rasmi kuwa iko hatarini.

reason.en: Rhoicissus, a forest relative in the grape family
reason.sw: Rhoicissus, jamaa wa msituni katika familia ya mizabibu

mgombato: doka to tear, to break off, to come apart (e.g. a piece of rope); kukatika.
